headline: Laver Cup Day 2 at The O2: Alcaraz, Zverev, and Fritz headline double-point Saturday
whyCareReason: Point values double on Saturday at The O2 as Carlos Alcaraz takes on Taylor Fritz and Alexander Zverev faces Alex de Minaur with two points awarded per win.
teaser: Saturday 26 September at The O2. Day 2 brings 2 points per win: Alcaraz vs Fritz, Zverev vs De Minaur, and evening doubles. First team to 13 points.
story:
Why this one matters: The stakes double on Saturday 26 September at The O2 Arena in London as the 9th Laver Cup enters Day 2.

Following Friday's fierce opening encounters, Captains Yannick Noah and Andre Agassi submitted Saturday's high-stakes lineup. Under Laver Cup rules, each match victory on Saturday is worth two points, raising the bar for both benches.

World No. 2 Carlos Alcaraz steps onto the black court for Team Europe against US Open finalist Taylor Fritz. US Open champion Alexander Zverev battles Australia's Alex de Minaur, followed by a blockbuster evening doubles clash. With 13 points needed to hoist the trophy, Saturday's four matches offer eight critical points.
stakes: Saturday points count double (2 points per win). A dominant day puts either team on the brink of the 13 required points.
rivalryAngle: Europe against the rest of the world, in a building that already hosted this event in 2022.
